redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages, search results and manuals retained only as audit receipts; access does not grant dataset reproduction, transformation, database storage, redistribution or public serving.
An exact official distribution under explicit open reuse terms with attribution, edition, date, schema, CRS, coverage and digest pinned; its authority remains limited to its declared subject.
Purchased, permissioned, credentialed or otherwise controlled material used only as specifically permitted.
Personal, customer, ownership, shipment, credential or private property evidence is excluded from public artifacts.

sources.production_scope: Only a separately authorized current complete PNA assignment/exception release may supply production rows. The July 2026 public PDF and its extracted text are audit receipts only and are not bundled or transformed into an AGID dataset.
A minimal non-personal result may validate expected public behavior at a capture time. Search HTML is not a bulk source, licence grant, fixed distribution or geometry authority.

Exact PRG or related official distributions may supply their declared administrative/address context under pinned reuse terms. They do not supply PNA postal-area geometry merely because postal codes or addresses can be associated with locations.

artifact_partitions.rule: Current Poczta PNA assignment, exception/membership semantics, edition, date, terms and digest remain operator evidence separate from geometry.
Only exact authoritative PNA Polygon/MultiPolygon features can be served as areas; organization, route, P.O.-box, point, membership-only and missing features remain explicit non-areas.
PRG, TERYT, locality, street, address and administrative geometry retain their own authority and never become postal area by relabelling, union, buffer or nearest match.
Minimal non-personal lookup receipts may test expected public behavior but never become a bulk distribution or production artifact.
Purchased lists, credentials, customers, recipients, owners, rightsholders, shipments and private property records never enter the open country seed.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
